outcomes.outcome: every base component is applied together on an Ubuntu node (packages, monitoring scripts, SSH, firewall, IPv6 drop, local tree, lib64 link, apt scripts, restricted tools)
SSH negotiates only node_base's ciphers, MACs and key exchange, admits keys only, and refuses root
the firewall is firewall_secure (not the extra variant) with the node's ACL whitelisted for SSH, and IPv6 is dropped
unattended upgrades are not installed (node_base passes unattended_upgrades false)
the apt update scripts use the server surface list (server_mode true), with no desktop link
the network tools are restricted to the group Hiera names for Ubuntu
time is kept by the ntp module's service (ntpsec on Ubuntu 24.04) from the Hiera servers, and it synchronises
with no nameservers given, the node's DNS setup is left as it is
no boot-time agent run unless asked (run_puppet_on_boot false)
on RedHat, firewalld is stopped, disabled and masked, chrony keeps the time, and filesystem_yum replaces the apt scripts
strict SSH, firewall purge off with ignore patterns, and the boot run, when their parameters are set
custom NTP servers, nameservers and the extra firewall when their parameters are set
